headline: Your Partner

hero.body: Ruxin Consulting is an Ethiopia-based FDI consulting firm committed to simplifying the way businesses establish, operate, and grow in Ethiopia.

headline: One partner for
doing business in Ethiopia.
about.body: We assist clients in navigating Ethiopia’s business environment through practical consulting, regulatory coordination, and tailored administrative solutions.
paragraphs: Navigating Ethiopia’s business environment can involve complex administrative procedures, multiple government institutions, and fragmented service systems. These challenges can create additional time, coordination, and resource demands for businesses, particularly international investors unfamiliar with the local environment.

Ruxin addresses these challenges through an integrated, one-stop service approach, bringing together essential business support services under one roof. From investment consulting and government liaison to logistics and customs clearance, financial services, recruitment, and legal support, we help clients coordinate their business needs through a single, reliable partner.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To become Ethiopia’s trusted one-stop business solutions partner, simplifying the business environment for foreign investors and enabling international enterprises to thrive.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To simplify foreign investment operations by integrating essential consulting and support services into a coordinated, client-centered solution that reduces complexity, improves efficiency, and supports sustainable business growth.

values.title: Integrity
values.body: We uphold honesty, transparency, and ethical conduct in every professional relationship.

values.title: Efficiency

values.title: Client-centricity
values.body: We place our clients at the center of our work, developing responsive and tailored solutions to meet their needs.

values.title: Reliability
values.body: We prioritize consistent communication, careful follow-up, and dependable service delivery.

values.title: Collaboration
values.body: We connect services and professionals, to provide coordinated solutions and a more seamless client experience.

values.title: Continuous improvement
values.body: We continuously seek better ways to deliver our services, strengthen our capabilities, and create lasting value for our clients.

services.name: Investment Consultancy
services.title: Guidance through Ethiopia’s investment process.
services.description: We guide foreign investors through Ethiopia’s investment regulations and requirements, providing clarity on applicable procedures and assisting them throughout the business registration and licensing process.

services.name: Customs Clearing
services.title: Import and export, without the delay.
services.description: We facilitate customs clearance by coordinating documentation, regulatory requirements, and relevant procedures to help businesses navigate import and export processes more smoothly and reduce unnecessary delays.

services.name: Financial Reporting
services.title: Reports that meet local requirements.
services.description: We assist businesses with the preparation of monthly and annual financial reports in accordance with applicable local regulations, helping clients meet their reporting obligations and maintain proper financial documentation.

services.name: Recruitment
services.title: Teams that fit the work.
services.description: We connect businesses with qualified talent by supporting candidate sourcing, screening, and recruitment coordination — helping clients build capable teams that align with their operational needs and business goals.

services.name: Legal Advisory
services.title: Legal clarity for doing business here.
services.description: We provide legal guidance and document review to help businesses understand relevant legal and regulatory requirements, address contractual matters, and navigate business-related legal procedures with greater confidence.

careers.headline: Build your future with us.
careers.body: We are looking for ambitious people who want to solve meaningful problems and create real impact.
benefits: Health coverage for you and your family

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.summary: Lead client engagements from diagnosis to delivery across strategy and operations.
jobs.description: You will own client relationships and lead multidisciplinary teams to solve strategic and operational challenges for organizations across the region.
responsibilities: Lead engagements end to end, from scoping to delivery
Structure ambiguous problems and develop evidence-based recommendations
Coach junior consultants and contribute to firm knowledge
Build lasting relationships with senior client stakeholders
requirements: 6+ years in consulting, strategy, or corporate development
Strong analytical and storytelling skills
Experience presenting to executive audiences
Fluency in English; Amharic is a plus

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Manager
jobs.summary: Run day-to-day freight operations and continuously improve route performance.
jobs.description: You will manage freight coordination, carrier relationships, and customs workflows to keep client supply chains moving reliably.
responsibilities: Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments across modes
Manage carrier and customs broker relationships
Track KPIs and drive continuous improvement
Resolve exceptions quickly and transparently
requirements: 5+ years in logistics or supply chain operations
Knowledge of import/export and customs procedures
Comfort with data and logistics software
Calm under pressure, strong communicator

jobs.title: Recruitment Specialist
jobs.summary: Find, assess, and connect exceptional talent with our client organizations.
jobs.description: You will run full-cycle searches for specialist and leadership roles, building trusted relationships with candidates and clients alike.
responsibilities: Run full-cycle recruitment for client mandates
Map talent markets and build candidate pipelines
Conduct structured interviews and assessments
Advise clients on offers and onboarding
requirements: 3+ years in recruitment or talent acquisition
Excellent judgement of people and potential
Strong networking and communication skills
Experience with executive search is a plus

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.summary: Build models and analyses that inform major client financial decisions.
jobs.description: You will support financial advisory engagements with modelling, valuation, and reporting work that turns data into decisions.
responsibilities: Build and maintain financial models and valuations
Analyse performance data and prepare insights
Support due diligence and investment readiness
Prepare clear, client-ready reports
requirements: 2+ years in finance, audit, or banking
Advanced Excel and modelling skills
Degree in finance, economics, or similar
CFA/ACCA progress is a plus

jobs.title: Legal Consultant
jobs.summary: Review contracts and advise clients on compliance and corporate matters.
jobs.description: You will review, draft, and negotiate commercial agreements and advise clients on corporate and regulatory compliance.
responsibilities: Review and draft commercial contracts
Advise on corporate governance and compliance
Identify legal risks and recommend mitigations
Collaborate with consulting and finance teams
requirements: LLB and licensed to practise
4+ years of commercial or corporate law experience
Precise, clear written communication
Business-minded approach to legal advice
